description: This file contains implementations related to the 'rlw_iterator' for processing compressed bitmap data structures, specifically functions for initializing, traversing, discarding words, and discharging bits in an EWAH bitmap compression context.

methods.name: int next_word(struct rlw_iterator * it)
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next word in the bitmap buffer, updating internal state based on the current word.

methods.name: void rlwit_init(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * from_ewah)
methods.description: Initializes the rlw_iterator structure with data from an ewah_bitmap, setting up for traversal.

methods.name: void rlwit_discard_first_words(struct rlw_iterator * it,size_t x)
methods.description: Discards a specified number of words from the start of the iterator, handling run-length and literal words accordingly.

methods.name: size_t rlwit_discharge(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
methods.description: Discharges words from the iterator into an output ewah_bitmap, handling negation, and respecting maximum limits.

ctags.name: rlwit_discharge
ctags.signature: (struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
